body:
I did not take any psychedelic substances for over a year. But I have some experience with mdma, lsd, magic mushrooms and salvia.
I was taking some SSRI for like 3 to 4 months. (10mg/day escitalopram). I didn't mind it at first.
Last week I went to Amsterdam and bought 15 grams of Psilocybe tampanensis. I took this once before, but only like 6 grams, and mixed it with beer. Really nice.
So last week I started eating them truffles. I started with 6 grams. An hour and a half in, I started to feel something, but not much. So I ate all them truffles (really nasty ones). Normally I would go insane because of my low tolerance level for psychedlica. But with the SSRI's I almost didn't feel a thing. Visuals: absolutely nothing, Body: maybe some, like I smoked 2 joints in a row. But normally I would be tripping 10 times harder. The next day I stopped with them SSRI's.
Keep on trippin'
